lines.say: For years, people feared a backdoor, a secret way in, in a top crypto standard.
lines.text: For years, people feared a backdoor, a secret way in, in a top crypto standard.

lines.say: The answer was an old computer clock.
lines.text: The answer was an old computer clock.

lines.say: Elliptic curves are math shapes that protect digital signatures. In two thousand, nist published a set of standard curves.
lines.text: Elliptic curves are math shapes that protect digital signatures. In 2000, NIST published a set of standard curves.

lines.say: Each curve grows from one random number, its seed. The N S A gave the seeds, with no source.
lines.text: Each curve grows from one random number, its seed. The NSA gave the seeds, with no source.

lines.say: A chosen seed could hide a weak curve. A rumour named a joke phrase. Nobody found it.
lines.text: A chosen seed could hide a weak curve. A rumour named a joke phrase. Nobody found it.

lines.say: Anthropic asked Claude. It guessed that nineteen nineties code made each seed with a C function, L rand forty eight.
lines.text: Anthropic asked Claude. It guessed that 1990s code made each seed with a C function, lrand48.

lines.say: L rand forty eight hides one number inside, its state. The state decides every output.
lines.text: lrand48 hides one number inside, its state. The state decides every output.

lines.say: Each seed shows only part of each output. A math method, lattice reduction, still rebuilt the state.
lines.text: Each seed shows only part of each output. A math method, lattice reduction, still rebuilt the state.

lines.say: Then Claude ran the generator backwards to its start. Each start was a clock time, from May nineteen ninety seven to April nineteen ninety eight.
lines.text: Then Claude ran the generator backwards to its start. Each start was a clock time, from May 1997 to April 1998.

lines.say: The P two fifty six seed is draw one thousand eight hundred forty two, from a clock set on August sixteenth, nineteen ninety seven.
lines.text: The P-256 seed is draw 1,842, from a clock set on August 16, 1997.

lines.say: Each rebuilt state gives back all one hundred sixty bits of its seed. That does not happen by chance.
lines.text: Each rebuilt state gives back all 160 bits of its seed. That does not happen by chance.
